---
title: "References"
---

This page lists every source used in the portfolio in one place, so the projects and tutorials do not each need their own list. In the text I cite the sources in a short form, for example (course notes, Section 7.3.3) or (Salau's guide, Section 9). The table shows which entry each short form refers to.

| Short form in the text | Entry |
|---|---|
| course notes, Section 6.x or 7.x | Department of Statistical Sciences (2026a) |
| Part 1 slides | Department of Statistical Sciences (2026b) |
| Lecture 2 slides, Lecture 3 slides | Department of Statistical Sciences (2025a, 2025b) |
| Salau's guide | Salau (2026) |
| course notes, Chapter 1 | Erni (2026a) |
| course notes, Chapter 2 | Erni (2026b) |
| course notes, Chapter 3 | Erni (2026c) |

## Course material

Department of Statistical Sciences (2025a). *Time Series Analysis, Part 1: Lecture 2* [lecture slides]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Projects 1 and 3.

Department of Statistical Sciences (2025b). *Time Series Analysis, Part 1: Lecture 3, ARIMA Models* [lecture slides]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Project 1.

Department of Statistical Sciences (2026a). *Time Series Analysis and Forecasting* [course notes, Part 1]. Honours 2026, University of Cape Town. Used in Projects 1, 2 and 3.

Department of Statistical Sciences (2026b). *Time Series Analysis and Forecasting* [lecture slides, Part 1]. Honours 2026, University of Cape Town. Used in Project 1.

Erni, B. (2026a). *Chapter 1: Exponential Smoothing* [course notes]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Projects 3 and 4.

Erni, B. (2026b). *Chapter 2: Time Series Regression Models* [course notes]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Project 3.

Erni, B. (2026c). *Chapter 3: State-Space Models* [course notes]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Project 4.

Erni, B. (2026d).  State space tutorial sheet. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in the Section 2 state space tutorial (Question 1).

Erni, B. (2026e).  HMM tutorial sheet. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in the Section 2 HMM tutorial (Questions 2, 3 and 7).

Salau, S. *ARCH and GARCH guide* [course handout]. Honours Time Series Module, University of Cape Town. Used in Project 2.

## Papers cited through the course notes

I did not read these papers myself. I cite them as they are presented in the Part 1 course notes, Sections 7.5 and 7.6.

Bollerslev, T. (1986). Generalized autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity. *Journal of Econometrics*, 31(3), 307–327. Used in Project 2.

Engle, R. F. (1982). Autoregressive conditional heteroscedasticity with estimates of the variance of United Kingdom inflation. *Econometrica*, 50(4), 987–1007. Used in Project 2.

## Data

Eskom (2026). *RSA Contracted Demand and RSA Contracted Forecast, hourly, 1 April 2022 to 27 September 2026* [data set, file ESK19847]. Eskom Data Portal, supplied on request through the data request form. https://www.eskom.co.za/dataportal/data-request-form/, received 30 September 2026. Used in Projects 3 and 4.

darkmatternet (2026). *S&P 500 Stocks: 25 Years of Data (Updated Daily)*, version 140 [data set]. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/darkmatternet/s-and-p-500-stocks-25-years-of-data-updated-daily, accessed 17 August 2026. Used in Projects 1 and 2 and the Section 1 fundamentals practical.

- here: Projects 1 to 4, fundamentals practical
- lubridate: Projects 3 and 4
- patchwork: spectral analysis tutorial
- readr: Projects 1 and 2, fundamentals practical
- rugarch: Project 2
- tibble: Project 3

- tidyverse: spectral analysis tutorial
- tseries: Project 1, ARCH and GARCH tutorial
- tsibble: Project 1, fundamentals practical
